newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nine West cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nine West cut to hold.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Hank Wilson cut his rating on shares of Nine West Group Inc to hold from buy due to uncertainty about a Securities and Exchange Commission investigation into the company's revenue recognition policies.
-- Nine West announced the SEC inquiry late on Tuesday.
-- In written research, Wilson said little was known about the inquiry, but in a worst-case scenario investors could see Nine West restating past earnings or adjusting future expectations.
-- For the time being, however, Wilson maintained his 1997 estimate of $3.00/shr on revenues of $1.86 billion, as well as his 1998 estimate of $3.55/shr on revenues of $2.13 billion.
